code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # A full constant-color row/column is a separator. Copy the populated side/region.
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1 and all(grid[r][c]==grid[r][0] for c in range(w))]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1]
    if rows:
        # use first nonempty band, by repeating the sole patterned band
        cuts=[-1]+rows+[h]
        bands=[(a+1,b) for a,b in zip(cuts,cuts[1:]) if b>a+1]
        src=max(bands,key=lambda ab:sum(v!=5 for row in grid[ab[0]:ab[1]] for v in row))
        pattern=[row[:] for row in grid[src[0]:src[1]]]
        out=[row[:] for row in grid]
        for a,b in bands:
            for i in range(a,b): out[i]=pattern[(i-a)%len(pattern)][:]
        return out
    return [r[:] for r in grid]
'''

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    rbounds = [-1] + hr + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + vc + [w]
    regions = [(ra+1, rb, ca+1, cb) for ra,rb in zip(rbounds,rbounds[1:]) for ca,cb in zip(cbounds,cbounds[1:]) if rb>ra+1 and cb>ca+1]
    if not regions:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    src = max(regions, key=lambda q: sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(q[0],q[1]) for c in range(q[2],q[3])))
    pattern = [grid[r][src[2]:src[3]] for r in range(src[0],src[1])]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in regions:
        for r in range(r0,r1):
            for c in range(c0,c1):
                out[r][c] = pattern[(r-r0)%len(pattern)][(c-c0)%len(pattern[0])]
    return out
'''
